tasks.trigger: Collect an inclusive physical-line span for a multiline noqa range.
tasks.wrong: The final line is omitted and the slice starts one line late.
tasks.causal: Use an inclusive one-based key range and the corresponding zero-based source slice.
tasks.observation:
from argparse import Namespace
from flake8.processor import FileProcessor
options=Namespace(hang_closing=False,indent_size=4,max_line_length=79,max_doc_length=None,verbose=0)
processor=FileProcessor('example.py',options,lines=['one\n','two\n','three\n'])
result=processor._noqa_line_range(1,2)
print('noqa_range',result)
assert result=={1:'one\ntwo\n',2:'one\ntwo\n'}

tasks.trigger: Advance a processor after a completed top-level logical line.
tasks.wrong: History fields receive blank counts/token objects and per-line fields reset to invalid values.
tasks.causal: Record the completed logical text and indent, retain top-level history, then clear tokens and blank count.
tasks.observation:
from argparse import Namespace
from flake8.processor import FileProcessor
options=Namespace(hang_closing=False,indent_size=4,max_line_length=79,max_doc_length=None,verbose=0)
processor=FileProcessor('example.py',options,lines=['x=1\n'])
processor.logical_line='x=1'
processor.indent_level=0
processor.blank_lines=3
processor.next_logical_line()
print('logical_history',processor.previous_logical,processor.previous_unindented_logical_line,processor.tokens,processor.blank_lines)
assert processor.previous_logical=='x=1' and processor.previous_unindented_logical_line=='x=1'
assert processor.previous_indent_level==0 and processor.tokens==[] and processor.blank_lines==0

tasks.trigger: Read source bytes with an explicit Latin-1 coding cookie through the real stdin decoder.
tasks.wrong: The byte buffer rewinds to offset one and drops the first decoded character.
tasks.causal: Rewind to byte zero after encoding detection and preserve the original decoding fallback contract.
tasks.observation:
import io,sys
from flake8 import utils
content=b"# coding: latin-1\nvalue = '\xe9'\n"
sys.stdin=io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(content),encoding='utf-8')
utils.stdin_get_value.cache_clear()
value=utils.stdin_get_value()
print('decoded_stdin',repr(value))
assert value==content.decode('latin-1')

tasks.trigger: Identify normal newline tokens and a source suffix continuing with a backslash.
tasks.wrong: Token text is compared to numeric kinds and the wrong source prefix is examined.
tasks.causal: Use token kind and the remaining suffix at the token end for continuation detection.
tasks.observation:
import tokenize
from flake8.processor import is_eol_token
newline=tokenize.TokenInfo(tokenize.NEWLINE,'\n',(1,3),(1,4),'x=1\n')
continued=tokenize.TokenInfo(tokenize.NAME,'x',(1,0),(1,1),'x \\\n')
ordinary=tokenize.TokenInfo(tokenize.NAME,'x',(1,0),(1,1),'x=1\n')
print('eol_classification',is_eol_token(newline),is_eol_token(continued),is_eol_token(ordinary))
assert is_eol_token(newline) and is_eol_token(continued) and not is_eol_token(ordinary)

tasks.trigger: Report one explicitly selected code and one unmatched code through a real StyleGuide/DecisionEngine.
tasks.wrong: Every decision uses a hardcoded unrelated error code.
tasks.causal: Forward the actual code argument into the configured decision engine.
tasks.observation:
from argparse import Namespace
from flake8.style_guide import StyleGuide,Decision
from flake8.statistics import Statistics
options=Namespace(select=['E'],extend_select=[],ignore=[],extend_ignore=[],extended_default_select=[],extended_default_ignore=[])
guide=StyleGuide(options,None,Statistics())
selected=guide.should_report_error('E201')
ignored=guide.should_report_error('F401')
print('code_decisions',selected,ignored)
assert selected is Decision.Selected and ignored is Decision.Ignored

tasks.trigger: Build an AST for top-level code following an indented block.
tasks.wrong: Adding spaces between stored physical lines changes indentation and can make valid source invalid.
tasks.causal: Concatenate physical lines exactly, without injecting characters.
tasks.observation:
from argparse import Namespace
from flake8.processor import FileProcessor
options=Namespace(hang_closing=False,indent_size=4,max_line_length=79,max_doc_length=None,verbose=0)
import ast
processor=FileProcessor('example.py',options,lines=['if True:\n','    pass\n','pass\n'])
tree=processor.build_ast()
print('ast_nodes',[type(n).__name__ for n in tree.body])
assert len(tree.body)==2 and isinstance(tree.body[0],ast.If) and isinstance(tree.body[1],ast.Pass)
assert tree.body[1].lineno==3 and tree.body[1].col_offset==0

tasks.trigger: Build a logical line from real Python tokens including an inline comment.
tasks.wrong: Comments and code are space-joined, result channels are swapped and statistics decrement.
tasks.causal: Concatenate the actual token text in its correct channel and increment logical-line statistics.
tasks.observation:
from argparse import Namespace
from flake8.processor import FileProcessor
options=Namespace(hang_closing=False,indent_size=4,max_line_length=79,max_doc_length=None,verbose=0)
import io,tokenize
processor=FileProcessor('example.py',options,lines=['x=1  # note\n'])
processor.tokens=list(tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO('x=1  # note\n').readline))
comments,logical,mapping=processor.build_logical_line()
print('built_logical',comments,logical,mapping,processor.statistics)
assert comments=='# note' and logical=='x=1' and processor.logical_line=='x=1'
assert processor.statistics['logical lines']==1 and mapping

tasks.trigger: Choose the most specific matching per-file style guide for a nested file.
tasks.wrong: Applicable guides are filtered out and the shortest remaining pattern is selected.
tasks.causal: Keep applicable guides and choose the longest filename pattern.
tasks.observation:
from argparse import Namespace
options=Namespace(select=None,extend_select=['F4'],ignore=[],extend_ignore=[],extended_default_select=['E'],extended_default_ignore=[],per_file_ignores=[])
from pathlib import Path
from flake8.style_guide import StyleGuideManager
options.per_file_ignores=['pkg/*.py:E123','pkg/sub/*.py:F401']
manager=StyleGuideManager(options,None)
filename=str(Path.cwd()/'pkg/sub/example.py')
guide=manager.style_guide_for(filename)
print('selected_guide',guide.filename)
assert guide.filename.endswith('pkg/sub/*.py')
